verdict.rationale: Copilot's own docs say its agents can "plan, explore, and execute work autonomously," and that Copilot in the editor handles "explaining concepts." Together these suggest it can explore a repo and explain it on its own, but nothing documents mapping or explaining a whole unfamiliar codebase with automatic context gathering. missing for 10: explicit documentation of whole-repository indexing or automatic context retrieval, a documented codebase-explanation or architecture-mapping workflow, evidence that no manual file selection is needed, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files

citations.quote: let them plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in the background
Copilot in your editor does it all, from explaining concepts and completing code
